titleEn: AgriFood Signals: DoorDash to buy Instacart, Terradot lands $34m, Biosphere wins Pentagon contract
titleZh: AgFunderNews农业食品信号：DoorDash拟收购Instacart，Terradot获3400万美元，Biosphere赢五角大楼合同
summaryZh: AgFunderNews汇总了农业科技与食品科技领域近期最重要的融资、并购、关闭及行业动态。本期重点包括：DoorDash以170亿美元收购Instacart；Terradot获3400万美元债务融资用于碳移除项目；Biosphere赢得五角大楼合同以扩大关键化学品生产；此外还有Epoch、Strella、FLTRD、Senara、IntegriCulture等多笔早期融资，以及Ground Up Investing首关2000万美元农业债务基金、Nofence人事任命、ADM肯尼亚小农项目扩展、Volare昆虫蛋白工厂投产、TurtleTree总部迁至荷兰等动态。
featuredReason: 本期汇总涵盖农业食品科技投融资与并购全景，虽与智慧畜牧直接关联有限，但DoorDash收购Instacart、碳移除融资、昆虫蛋白工厂及细胞农业等动态反映了食品供应链与替代蛋白领域的资本走向，可供智慧畜牧从业者把握跨领域趋势与潜在合作机会。
contentFull:
AgFunderNews rounds up the most important fundings, mergers, acquisitions, closures, and industry buzz in agtech and foodtech.

Funding news

🇺🇸 Terradot closes $34M debt for carbon removal projects Axios

🇬🇧 Epoch raises $4.25 million to help SMEs comply with EUDR supply chain deforestation regulation ESG Today

🇺🇸 Seattle ag-tech startup Strella lands $4.25m Geekwire

🇻🇳 Japan’s OC Global makes strategic investment in Vietnam’s ECONUTI Vietnam Investment Review

🇳🇱 As Brussels scrutinises ultra-processed food, FLTRD raises €500K+ to scale across Europe Tech.eu

🇩🇪 Lab-grown milk startup Senara lands LIOF investment Innovation Origins

🇯🇵 IntegriCulture secures Niigata backing to build cell agriculture around Japan’s brewing industry Protein Production Technology [Disclosure: AgFunderNews’ parent company AgFunder is an investor in IntegriCulture.]
